skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic to advanced concepts of database querying.
Understand fundamental concepts of database management systems including indexing, views, triggers, stored procedures, user management, and data security.
Apply theoretical models, relational algebra expressions, and SQL syntax to analyze, evaluate, and explain issues related to query optimization and data integrity.
Proficiently use one of the following database management systems: MS SQL Server, Access, MySQL.
Design databases up to 5NF normalization level and apply basic principles of database design processes for operational activities.
Analyze and synthesize data to provide information support for decision-making processes.
Understand different database models and have analytical, advisory, and supportive skills for digital transformation processes.
Work independently or actively, positively, and effectively in group activities.
Have organizational skills for group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Systems Management.
